capabilities.title: Privacy-hardened browser with fingerprint randomization and tracker blocking
capabilities.sourceEvidence: CloakBrowser: purpose-built browser for anonymous web access
capabilities.reason: Nexus is a dashboard application, not a browser. Shipping an embedded browser runtime is outside product scope.

capabilities.title: Browser fingerprint randomization concepts: canvas, WebGL, audio, font fingerprint spoofing
capabilities.sourceEvidence: CloakBrowser fingerprinting docs: entropy reduction techniques
capabilities.reason: Canvas, WebGL, audio, and font spoofing require control of a browser runtime. Nexus is an application inside the user's browser and cannot honestly provide fingerprint randomization.

capabilities.title: Curated tracker blocking list for OSINT requests
capabilities.sourceEvidence: CloakBrowser tracker block list: maintained deny-list of tracking scripts
capabilities.reason: Nexus uses server-side connector boundaries, private-network rejection, explicit host/protocol validation, and curated source registries so RECON does not execute arbitrary third-party tracking scripts in the client.

capabilities.title: Proxy rotation integrated with browser requests for OSINT anonymity
capabilities.sourceEvidence: CloakBrowser proxy rotation: per-session proxy assignment
capabilities.reason: Proxy rotation would add an unaudited traffic-interception dependency and can facilitate evasion. Nexus keeps attributable, policy-guarded connector requests instead.
